7. device_test.py --smoke (spark-eight, CPU + interpreter)       ALL PASS       results/smoke.log
   - harness code paths only; NOT a gate. Now runs anchor, bitwise (incl. the per-bucket sweeps), ties, mutants and
     dispatch (row and tile children: install.py's patch of the venv file applied in a temp dir, == c77844fb,
     r4.certified_logits -> r6, self-check, _done, stats line, out-flip / hi-flip mutants caught by the self-check).
   - The first smoke run after the fixes FAILED in the row dispatch child at M=17: the self-check reported
     "argmax differs". Cause: the interpreter's bf16 dot runs on raw bit patterns, so the certificate l <= hi does
     not hold there and a row-mode argmax may legitimately differ. In SMOKE mode only, an M whose live pass breaks
     the certificate is now skipped for row mode, with an INFO line (M=17 'flat'). On the device nothing is skipped.
     Rerun: ALL PASS.

  and it now includes anchor (r4.certified_logits flags-off == r6._run(...,False,'0') at every M), the per-bucket
  config sweeps, and dispatch (the installed path on the GPU).
- Any serving arm (hcheck / hrow / htile / hscr / hall): lead's window.
- The CERTPRE micro-bench (device_test.py --part l2): GPU.
- No lever in this kit has passed a device or serving test.
